scope: Existing isolated parser copy only; not a new engine/import/test and not the failed CI archive

newly_generated_format.rule: Exactly uid:// + 1..13 base34 digits [a-y0-8] + LF; canonical 0..2^63-1 encoding

recommendations: Keep tracked sources and tracked UID bytes guarded by the existing exact pinned source checks.
Allow only new regular .gd.uid/.gdshader.uid adjacent to exact tracked regular source blobs, with no symlink or unsafe path traversal.
Keep any explicitly authorized QA overlay UID separate from product metadata.
Record exact sidecar path set, raw byte hashes, base paths and expected source blobs after import and require equality through the actual QA run.
Reject unrelated untracked files, invalid or multiline content, missing/nontracked bases, wrong source blobs, removed/added/changed sidecars.
Do not apply new generator-only UID format validation retroactively to tracked historical UID strings.
limitations: UID values are resource identifiers, not a substitute for source content integrity checks.
Observed local sidecar counts are not attributed to the failed CI artifact.
No QA runtime, renderer, import, test or product/ref change occurred in this review.

runner_review.result: No concrete blocker found within the requested metadata-guard diff
runner_review.review_method: Read-only complete old/new runner comparison and read-only fixture source review; reviewer did not execute the runner or fixtures
preserved_guards: Exact pinned Host/Native HEAD, tree and clean tracked index/worktree checks still run before metadata validation.
The dedicated QA commit remains constrained to the original four added QA paths and the frozen Host parent.
Tracked UID bytes remain included in the existing tracked-source snapshots and are not reinterpreted by new-generator format rules.
The exact GDScript and Dart overlay bytes remain independently compared with their committed QA originals.
All non-allowed untracked native paths in the existing monitored source scope are still rejected.
verified_changes: Only .gd.uid/.gdshader.uid suffixes are considered; their basename must resolve to one HEAD tree entry with regular source mode and exact current source blob.
Sidecar itself must be a regular non-symlink file and exactly one ASCII LF-terminated UID line using the actual generator alphabet.
The integer must fit the engine's signed-63-bit range; leading-a zero aliases are rejected except the canonical single-character zero encoding.
The sorted generated_native_uid_metadata inventory contains path, source path, expected source Git blob, UID text, byte length, SHA256 and Git blob of sidecar bytes.
The existing finally-path requires the entire before/after snapshot equality, including the separate UID inventory; additions, removals and edits cannot silently pass.
No blanket exception for the untracked QA-overlay UID remains; a newly observed such file would fail rather than silently enter product metadata.
practical_limits: No change to the original Dart or Native QA assertions was part of this review.
The metadata fixture outcomes belong to the implementing parent's execution evidence, not to this source review.
No claim is made that UID formatting alone authenticates a resource binding or that this replaces actual QA execution.
No new game runtime, renderer, screenshot, Android run or measured performance was observed here.
The original failed QA run had not reached the actual Dart/Godot probe; its failure is not a game-input result.
